seo.title: Invoices
seo.seo_description: The system reads your supplier invoices (PDF, scan, photo), extracts the amounts, flags discrepancies and files everything in a table. A person approves.

blocks.role: Promesse de la solution factures : fini de retaper, les écarts remontent.

translation.headline: Stop retyping your invoices.
translation.subheadline: The system reads each invoice, PDF, scan or photo, extracts the fields you have defined and shows you what looks doubtful first. Payment and accounting stay in a person's hands.

blocks.role: Problème : exemple construit d'un atelier d'usinage qui reçoit des formats variés.

translation.title: When every invoice arrives differently.
translation.body:
Imagine a machining shop. A metal supplier sends a PDF by email, a carrier a photo taken at the dock, another a crooked scan. Someone retypes the numbers, dates and amounts, then works out who has to approve.

The example is constructed to illustrate the principle; it is not a customer's result.

items.title: Assorted formats.
items.text: Digital PDF, scan, photo: each is read differently.

items.title: Typing errors.
items.text: A transposed amount slips through to approval, even to payment.

items.title: A queue nobody can see.
items.text: No one can tell at a glance what is received, checked, approved.

blocks.role: Ce que fait le système : lecture, extraction, vérification, rangement.

translation.title: One invoice in, one row out.
translation.intro: The steps are those of a WorkStudio workflow (an automated sequence of tasks), built without writing code. WorkStudio puts AI reading of scanned documents within your reach, with the human oversight it needs.

cards.title: It reads.
cards.text: A digital PDF is read directly; an image or a scanned PDF goes through a document-reading model. Scans are read more slowly.

cards.title: It extracts.
cards.text: You define the fields (number, date, supplier, amounts, taxes, project number); the system looks for them in each document.

cards.title: It checks.
cards.text: A missing required field, an unreadable value or a total that does not add up: the document is marked "to review", with the reason.

cards.title: It files.
cards.text: One row per document in a table, ready for what comes next. What comes next waits for a person.

blocks.role: Ce que reçoit l'équipe : mosaïque de bénéfices concrets (bento).

translation.title: A table instead of a pile.
translation.intro: The team opens a table, not a pile of email. Safe documents go by quickly; doubtful ones rise to the top.

cards.title: A table of documents.
cards.text: One row per invoice, with the fields you have chosen.

cards.title: A "to review" flag.
cards.text: With the reason: missing field, unreadable value, total that does not add up.

cards.title: A simple conclusion.
cards.text: The starter template "supplier invoice check" concludes "to pay" or "to review".

cards.title: The text as read, kept.
cards.text: The document as it was read is kept, so you can compare it with the original.

blocks.role: Bénéfice attendu, sans chiffre ; lien diagnostic.

translation.title: Errors caught before payment.
translation.body:
Less retyping, errors caught before approval rather than after payment, a clear view of what is left to process. We announce no accuracy percentage and no time saved: reading quality depends on your documents and is measured during a pilot, on your own invoices.

Book a diagnosis to put the reading to the test on your documents.

blocks.role: Ce qui reste sous contrôle, y compris les limites ; carte données avec lien Vos données.

cards.title: No automatic payment.
cards.text: The system pays nothing. Approval and payment stay with a person.

cards.title: No entry without approval.
cards.text: Writing to your accounting software goes through a connector to be qualified, after approval. Not all software connects in the same way.

cards.title: Your fields, your taxes.
cards.text: The starter templates are general and do not follow Quebec tax rules: your fields (GST, QST, project number) are defined with us, then checked on your documents.

cards.title: A person reviews the doubts.
cards.text: Anything marked "to review" passes under someone's eyes.

cards.title: Your data stays yours.
cards.text: On your server or with us, in Quebec: never used to train a model, never sold. A reading model on your server keeps the documents with you; an external service comes in only when you explicitly activate it, in writing.

blocks.role: FAQ propre à la solution factures.

items.question: Can it read crooked scanned invoices?
items.answer: It reads images and scanned PDFs with a document-reading model, more slowly than a digital PDF. Quality depends on how sharp the scan is; anything doubtful is marked "to review".

items.question: Does it connect to my accounting software?
items.answer: Maybe: it depends on the software. We check during the diagnosis. Without a connection, the table can serve as the basis for faster data entry, approved by your accountant.

items.question: What about Quebec taxes?
items.answer: They are not handled by default. We define with you the tax fields to extract and the checks to run, then put them to the test on your documents.

items.question: Can it also handle quotes and expense reports?
items.answer: Starter templates exist for quotes, purchase orders and expense reports. They can be customized like the invoice one.

translation.title: Watch your invoices read themselves.
translation.text: We prepare a demonstration on fictional invoices, then we talk about your documents, your fields and your accounting. A partner from here installs, runs and trains with you.
